definitions.explanation: A topical cream, lotion, or oral medicine that relieves itching from insect bites, rashes, or allergies.

examples.japanese: かゆみ{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}った→塗る：01174_nuru⟧。
⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺|さ}された→刺す：02111_sasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、かゆみ{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧きた。
examples.english: I got bitten by a bug, so I bought some anti-itch medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湿疹|しっしん}→湿疹：06951_shisshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かかないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、かゆみ{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}って→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦あげた→あげる：00546_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I put anti-itch cream on my child so they wouldn't scratch the rash.

notes:
Formed from ⟦かゆみ→かゆみ：07278_kayumi⟧ (itch) + {止|ど}め (stopper, from ⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧ "to stop"). The same {〜止|ど}め pattern names many remedies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- かゆみ{止|ど}め⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to apply anti-itch cream
- かゆみ{止|ど}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: anti-itch medicine

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{痛|いた}み{止|ど}め→痛み止め：23497_itamidome⟧: painkiller
- ⟦{虫|むし}{除|よ}け→虫除け：09715_mushiyoke⟧: insect repellent
